box.highlights: Sayville 41, Harborfields 14: Jack Smalley threw for 184 yards and three touchdowns on 15-of-24 passing in Suffolk III. Matthew Bonfanti caught two touchdown passes. Smalley's 31-yard strike to Bonfanti in the first quarter gave Sayville a 13-0 lead. Bonfanti caught another 8-yard touchdown from Kyle Messina in the second quarter that pushed the lead to 19-0. Mack Murtha caught touchdown passes of 15 and 5 yards from Smalley. Benny Sands made nine tackles, including four for a loss and recovered a fumble.

Sayville 9, Comsewogue 3: Jack Smalley found Mack Murtha for a 70-yard touchdown in the third quarter to break a tie at 3 for Sayville (2-0) in Suffolk III. Benny Sands and Danny O'Doherty each had 10 tackles and Charlie Sands added eight tackles and a sack in the win.  Kyle Messina rushed for 88 yards on 11 carries and had two receptions for 46 yards for Sayville.

Sayville 42, Kings Park 14: Mack Murtha had two receiving touchdowns and an 85-yard kick-off return touchdown to lead Sayville (3-0) in Suffolk III. The kickoff return touchdown opened the scoring for Sayville and Murtha's 81-yard receiving touchdown from Jack Smalley in the second quarter gave them a 13-7 lead. Smalley connected to Matt Bonfanti for a 10-yard touchdown pass with nine seconds left in the second quarter to go up 28-14 at the half. Smalley had three passing touchdowns. Kyle Mesina rushed for 112 yards and two touchdowns.

Kyle Messina rushed 22 times for 162 yards and three touchdowns - on runs of 5, 53 and 29 yards - as the Sayville improved to 4-0 in Suffolk III. Jack Smalley completed 6-9 passes for 87 yards including a 20-yard touchdown to Macklin Murtha, Thomas Golio returned a fumble 24 yards for a touchdown and Benny Sands had a forced fumble, a  fumble recovery, 7 tackles,  and three tackles for a loss for the Golden Flashes. Michael Argenziano was 5-for-5 on extra points.
For Westhampton (0-3), Deegan Laube caught a 4-yard touchdown pass from Geoff Arrasate and Zack Fuhrmann and Frank Noto each had three tackles for a loss.

Sayville 42, Rocky Point 14: Kyle Messina rushed for 155 yards on 10 carries, including an 8-yard touchdown run, and Tom Cea Jr. rushed for 32 yards and two touchdowns on six carries for Sayville (5-0) in Suffolk III. Joey Byrne added a 20-yard touchdown run in the win. Messina also completed 4 of 6 passes for 34 yards, including a 5-yard touchdown pass to Patrick Folks. Jack Smalley completed 8 of 13 passes for 148 yards, including a 52-yard touchdown pass to Mack Murtha.  Charlie Sands added 79 receiving yards, Dan O'Doherty and Benny Sands each had seven tackles and Colin Gover had five tackles and a sack in the win. Cody Miller rushed for two touchdowns for Rocky Point (2-3).

Sayville 14, Islip 7: Jack Smalley found Chad Moccio for a 25-yard touchdown with two minutes remaining in the third quarter to break a tie at 7 for Sayville (7-0).  Mack Murtha had two interceptions and Jayson Filosa had six pass breakups in the win. Kyle Messina ran a 4-yard touchdown in the first quarter to open the scoring for Sayville. Islip falls to 5-2.

Sayville 28, Hauppauge 2: Mack Murtha and Jay Filosa returned interceptions for touchdowns to lead Sayville (8-0) in a 28-point first quarter. Murtha's return went for 65 yards, while Filosa's runback went for 25. Murtha also scored on a 26-yard pass from Jack Smalley, and Charlie Sands ran the ball in from the 5. Only a fourth-quarter safety got in the way of a shutout. Sands finished with 66 yards on 17 carries.

Sayville 29, Harborfields 13: Kyle Messina had 24 carries for 164 yards and two touchdowns to lead No. 1 Sayville over No. 8 Harborfields in a Suffolk Division III quarterfinal. Mack Murtha's 17-yard interception return in the first quarter extended gave the Golden Flashes a 16-0 advantage. Murtha also hauled in a 39-yard touchdown reception in the fourth to extend the lead to 29-7. Geffner Brett recorded three sacks and Anthony Contaldi had an interception and a fumble recovery in the win. Sayville (9-0) advances to the semifinals on Nov. 12 at 7 p.m.

East Islip 35, Sayville 28
Derek Burrell rushed 20 times for 178 yards and 3 touchdowns including the game winning 31 yard run with 19 seconds left in the Division III final for East Islip. Burrell also completed 7 of 8 passes for 116 yards. The turning point of the game came in the third quarter when Sayville had the ball at the East Islip 1 yard line. An errant center snap was fumbled and picked up by Cooper Parkinson who returned the fumble 94 yards for a 28-21 East Islip lead. Carson Tessitore and Ryan Bayer combined on two sacks for the Redmen. This was the first Suffolk title for the Redmen since 2016 and their eighth overall. Both teams are now 10-1.This was the 150th win in Sal J. Ciampi's career. He is 150-60 in his 21 year as  the coach of the Redmen. East Islip will play Plainedge in the Long Island Class III final on Friday November 26 at Hofstra University at 4:30 p.m.
